append.vision_segment: Localization also carries a single-view support estimate: support_z_m is the height of the surface the target stands on, fitted to depth pixels just outside its mask and evaluated under it; height_above_support_m is the visible top's height above that surface; mid_height_z_m is the midpoint between them; support_point_count counts the pixels that support the fit, and the three heights are null when no support is visible. center_xyz_m is a visible-surface median, so from an oblique or overhead camera it sits near the top; for a parallel-jaw side grasp, use mid_height_z_m as the height reference instead. The estimate is not ground truth: a neighbouring object, a container wall or a hidden base can bias it.
